name: datatable-basic
description: Minimal DataTable (hs-uix) — the default list-card primitive. Prop is `data` not `rows`. Column key is `field` not `name`. `searchFields` lists which fields the built-in search input searches. Set `sortable: true` per column to enable header sort. This is the shape you should reach for first for any list — raw Table is only for cases DataTable can't express.
